title: Root DIO rejection relies on indirect rank comparison
description: File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs Lines 370-378. Root nodes reject DIOs through an indirect mechanism - the rank comparison (dio.rank >= self.rank) - rather than an explicit role check. For a root (rank=256), any valid DIO is rejected because no valid parent can have rank < 256. A maintainer might add a fix that bypasses this check, breaking root behavior. Add comment explaining this mechanism.
